title: Emrys and the Bakery
author: Theo Whitlock
blurb: Jonah Sterling, a vineyard owner who inherited debts instead of grapes, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. Then a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces before the vineyard's first harvest comes in.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
